title: Figure 40. Thor Launch Summary (bar chart, Thor not including Delta)
description: Stacked bar chart of Number of Thor Missions per Launch Year, with black segments for "Normal Performance" and white segments for "Failure/Anomaly"; activity is concentrated between about 1957 and 1966, peaking near 32 launches around 1959–1960. Appears under heading "D.5 Thor Launch and Performance History (Not Including Delta)", followed by Section D.5.1 describing the columns of Table 46. Captioned "Figure 40. Thor Launch Summary".
